observations.trace: The fallible public install mutates instances per placement and appends its layout proof after the loop. StoreyIndex::new(65536) is constructible in memory and serialized_ordinal returns Err; placing it second after an assumed successful placement leaves an instance without that installation proof.
observations.remaining: Normal worker and tactical generate paths discard a local failed scene/result, and exact wire serialization of the out-of-range ordinal is rejected. No actual invalid layout, direct caller, worker, error, retry or product was executed.

observations.trace: Occupancy::cells enumerates every inclusive16m cell in a finite footprint bounding box and insert pushes the footprint per cell. Under the stated ordinary identity-rotation result, a finite centre-zero square with half extents1,000,000m has cell indices −62500..62500 on both axes, or 125001² = 15625250001 theoretical cell visits if enumeration completes. FurnitureFootprint admission checks finite corners and nonnegative finite extents, not this work budget.
observations.remaining: Occupancy is private and no actual reservation producer for that square has been established; allocations may fail before completion. Earlier urban index expansion may be encountered first for large street inputs. This is related to REVIEW-URBAN-BUCKET-SPAN-CAPACITY-001 but is a distinct implementation/consumer whose first-contract and alias relationship remain open; no extra finding or runtime cost is claimed.

observations.trace: Site recipes retain local collision-relative routes and convert them to checked scene footprints at placement; market perimeter and crossing routes are created before candidates, and obstacle footprints include the matching building and tree/rock reservations.
observations.remaining: Actual large reservation producers, all gate sweep/native physics and supporting-collision lifecycles remain open. Source test assertions are not execution.

conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional public mutation after typed error
conditional_findings.first_contract: A public fallible interior installation needs an explicit failure-state contract so retained furniture instances and their matching interior proof remain coherent after an error.
conditional_findings.classification: New current source assessment of the same original059 pending interior-install family; no historical unique-count increment.
conditional_findings.trace: FurnitureLayout::install_interior delegates to install, which converts and pushes each layout placement into instances in order, then appends InteriorBuildingLayout only after the loop. InteriorLayout and InteriorPlacement expose their fields, and StoreyIndex::new accepts usize while serialized_ordinal rejects values above u16::MAX. Assume a valid building and one placement p0 whose conversion succeeds. A direct caller supplies a layout with p0 followed by a copy whose storey is StoreyIndex::new(65536). The first instance is pushed; the second calls floor_height, which calls serialized_ordinal and returns a typed ordinal error. install returns Err before adding the interior proof, leaving the first instance in the caller-owned FurnitureLayout. This is a source-control-flow example; no building, layout, install, worker or product was executed.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The constructed out-of-range StoreyIndex is an in-memory public-constructor case; its serializer itself rejects the value and its deserializer reads u16, so do not claim this exact example arrives on the wire. A successful first placement and valid building are assumptions, not constructed fixtures. The selected PreparedVenue worker furnishes the same recipe plan, and PreparedStrategicScene::from_products creates its scene locally and returns Err if installation fails; the selected TacticalSceneInput::generate also discards its local generated result on furnish_interiors failure. Those paths do not by themselves expose this partial local object. Actual direct callers, retry behavior, accepted worker output, intended atomicity and user impact remain unobserved. The related multi-building append can similarly have earlier successful work, but no separate duplicate finding is asserted.
connected_repair_dependencies: Decide the public error-state and plan-association contract, and coordinate checked installation with validated worker recipes, instance identifiers, interior proof and repeated or multi-building append semantics.
Stage or otherwise make complete conversions reviewable before mutating the retained owner if atomic failure is required; preserve existing valid placement transforms and typed causes.

Later authorized verification should cover a valid placement followed by an out-of-range or missing-floor placement, a successful multi-placement case, existing contents and worker/scene error propagation; no product validation was performed.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; direct public in-memory control-flow witness and selected local caller safeguards, actual direct callers and failure policy remain open
